basis.request: Actively prepare annotated paper/report figures, reconstruct explanatory figures for shared reader context, and draw workflow control diagrams when original explanatory images are absent.

implementation.image_tool_selection: Image generation/editing for source-based visual explanation; deterministic vector or Mermaid for simple exact relationship diagrams.
scientific_invariants: Preserve original evidence figures and their scales, labels and scientific content.
Distinguish original relations, explanatory additions and hypotheses.
Identify arrow semantics and compare the rendered derivative to the source.

artifact_scope: Guidance only; no third-party figures redistributed, no generated picture, no new scientific result.
